window.ruled: Tony's ruling of 2026-11-20 ("Yes"), on the crossings measured from JPL that day: each twin's distance from Earth's centre every hour against the Hill sphere the page draws (235 Earth radii). Blue crossed inward last between 20:00 and 21:00 UTC on 18 October 2026; Gold crossed outward first between 09:00 and 10:00 UTC on 14 November 2026. The window runs from the hour before the one to the hour after the other, 26 days and 14 hours.

spans.from: the window, 2026-10-18 20:00 to 2026-11-14 10:00 UTC, turned to JPL's clock
ESCAPADE-Blue's flyby window on its entry (path.events), on JPL's clock
ESCAPADE-Gold's flyby window on its entry (path.events), on JPL's clock

clock_note: JPL was asked on its own clock (TDB). Each moment's UTC was worked out from its TDB Julian date by astropy, as was each pass's.
speed_note: Each speed was worked out once by tools/encounter_fetch.py as the square root of the sum of the squares of JPL's three velocity components at that moment (VX, VY, VZ), around the centre; nothing else in this file was worked out.
